facts.note: Twenty-three blocks west to east: the walled yard and the armoury behind it, nine across inside their walls, and moor grass either side.
Twenty-seven blocks north to south: the armoury, the yard in front of its door, and moor grass round both.
Five blocks from the door wall to the window wall inside the armoury: one room a body crosses in a few steps, so every stand, the frame and the chest are within reach of somebody standing in it.
